description: Months and interest to clear a credit card balance with a fixed monthly payment, compared with adding an extra monthly payment. A payment that never clears the balance returns null months and interest. Use when the user wants to clear a credit card balance and asks how long it takes or how much interest it costs. For several different debts use calculate_debt_payoff. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive credit card payoff calculator.

extra_payment.description: Extra payment added each month in USD; default 0.

name: calculate_credit_card_payoff

calculator_url.description: Deep link to the matching interactive calculator on everycalc.xyz.

inputs.description: The normalized inputs the calculation used.

results.description: The computed figures for this calculator.

tool.description: Name of the tool that ran.
